	has_target = no
	unique = yes
	expel_members_who_are_targets_of_other_members = no
	show_on_diplomatic_map = yes
	has_leader_country = yes
	leader_type = country
	leader_color = define:NMapColors|INTERNATIONAL_ORGANIZATION_LEADER_COLOR
	create_visible_trigger = { always = no }
	can_declare_war = { always = yes }
	leader_modifier = {
		monthly_prestige = 0.05
		diplomatic_capacity_modifier = 0.10
	}
	modifier = {
		monthly_prestige = 0.01
		global_trade_through_owned_territory_efficiency = 0.01
	}
	opinion_bonus = 5
	join_visible_trigger = { always = yes }
	join_enabled_trigger = { always = yes }
	invite_visible_trigger = { always = yes }
	invite_enabled_trigger = { always = yes }
	can_join_trigger = {
		OR = {
			tag = XAR
			tag = XAS
			tag = KUC
			tag = XAT
			tag = LOU
			tag = XAV
			tag = GMU
			tag = XGA
			tag = YQI
			tag = SHC
			tag = PUL
			tag = FJS
			tag = IWL
			tag = DNH
		}
		is_rebel_country = no
	}
	can_leave_trigger = { NOT = { is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient } }
	auto_leave_trigger = {
		NOT = {
			OR = {
				tag = XAR
				tag = XAS
				tag = KUC
				tag = XAT
				tag = LOU
				tag = XAV
				tag = GMU
				tag = XGA
				tag = YQI
				tag = SHC
				tag = PUL
				tag = FJS
				tag = IWL
				tag = DNH
			}
		}
	}
	auto_disband_trigger = { total_members < 2 }
	disband_minimum_member_count = 1
	on_joined = { add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus }
	on_left = { add_prestige = prestige_weak_penalty }
	monthly_effect = {
		random_list = {
			1 = {
				every_international_organization_member = {
					add_gold = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = -0.02 }
				}
			}
			59 = {}
		}
	}
	variables = {
		antq_cohesion = {
			monthly_change = 0.05
			start = 50
			min = 0
			max = 100
		}
	}
	ai_desire_to_join = { add = { desc = BASE_VALUE value = 25 } }
	ai_desire_to_allow_new_member = { add = { desc = WE_WANT_THE_ORGANIZATION_TO_GROW value = 20 } }
	only_leader_country_joins_defensive_wars = yes
	join_defensive_wars_auto_call = {
		scope:target ?= { NOT = { is_member_of_international_organization = root } }
	}
}
